units.source_text: 随手挥写，不拘形迹，却有优雅之趣。

en.t: It had been dashed off casually, without concern for form, yet it possessed an elegant charm.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得出乎意外，深感兴味，便对惟光说：“这里的西邻是哪一家，你探问过么？”

en.t: Prince Genji found it unexpected and was deeply intrigued, so he said to Koremitsu, "Have you inquired what household lies to the west of here?"

units.source_text: 惟光心里想：“我这主子的老毛病又发作了。”

en.t: Koremitsu thought to himself, "My master's old habit has started up again."

units.source_text: 但并不说破他，只是淡然地回答道：“我到这里住了五六天，但因家有病人，操心看护，没有探听过邻家的事。”

en.t: But he did not say so aloud, and merely answered calmly, "I have been staying here for five or six days, but because there is someone ill at home and I have been worried with nursing them, I have not asked about the neighbors."

units.source_text: 公子说：“你道我存心不良么？

en.t: The prince said, "Do you think I have improper intentions?

units.source_text: 非也，只为关于这把扇子的事，想问问看。

en.t: Not so; I only want to ask about this fan.

units.source_text: 你给我去找一个知道那家情况的人，打听一下吧。”

en.t: Go find someone who knows about that household and make some inquiries for me."

units.source_text: 惟光到那人家去向看门的人打听，回来报道：“这房子的主人是扬名介[\[9\]](#part1333.html#m9)。

en.t: Koremitsu went to that house and asked the gatekeeper, then returned and reported, "The master of this house is a Yomei no suke[\[9\]](#part1333.html#m9).

units.source_text: 听他们的仆役说：‘主人到乡下去了。

en.t: According to their servants, 'The master has gone to the countryside.

units.source_text: 主母年纪很轻，性喜活动。

en.t: The mistress is very young and has an active disposition.

units.source_text: 她的姐妹都是当宫人的，常常来这里走动。

en.t: Her sisters all serve at court and often come and go here.

units.source_text: ’详细的情况，这做仆役的不知道。”

en.t: ' As for the details, that servant did not know."

units.source_text: 源氏公子推想：“那么这把扇子是那些宫人用的。

en.t: Prince Genji surmised, "Then this fan must have been used by those court ladies.

units.source_text: 这首诗大约是熟练的得意之笔吧。”

en.t: This poem was probably written with a practiced and confident hand."

units.source_text: 又想：“这些人身份都不见得高贵；

en.t: He also thought, "These people are not necessarily of high rank;

units.source_text: 但特地赋诗相赠，此心却很可爱，我倒不能就此丢开了。”

en.t: but to compose a poem especially and send it is charming in spirit, and I cannot simply let the matter drop."

units.source_text: 他对这些事本来是很容易动心的。

en.t: He was by nature easily moved by such things.

units.source_text: 便在一张怀纸上用不像他自己的笔迹写道：

en.t: So on a sheet of folded paper, he wrote in a hand unlike his own:
